Class DrawingViewInfo

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.view.AbstractViewInfo
edu.cnu.mdi.view.DrawingViewInfo
public class DrawingViewInfo extends AbstractViewInfo
Describes the DrawingView for the in-app help / info dialog.

Returned by DrawingView.getViewInfo() and displayed when the user clicks the info button in the toolbar.
